children: Retail sales in Greece increased 1.9% year-on-year in June 2026, slowing from a downwardly revised one-year high of 6.7% in the previous month.
Sales growth eased for food (2.5% vs 7.9% in May) and the non-food sector excluding automotive fuel (4.0% vs 7.3%), while sales of automotive fuel fell further (-6.9% vs -0.4%).

Among specialized categories, retail activity also moderated in supermarkets (2.4% vs 7.2%), food, beverages, and tobacco (0.2% vs 8.2%), pharmaceutical products and cosmetics (3.3% vs 8.5%), and clothing and footwear (6.8% vs 8.6%).
At the same time, sales declined in department stores (-2.1% vs 1.9%) and books, stationery, and other goods (-0.6% vs 2.4%).
In contrast, sales edged up in furniture, electrical equipment, and household goods (10.9% vs 10.7%).
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, retail activity fell 1.4% in June, reversing a 3.3% gain in May.

title: Greece Retail Sales Growth Slows in June
